text:
kevin: seeing occasional "Unexpected end of JSON input" from node sdk when streaming. Repro in onboarding sample using fetch + AbortController when tab closed or when auth refresh hits.

maya: we saw similar in python but our iterator buffered differently. Node currently parses per-event and blows up if 'data:' spans chunks.

vikas: share tiny repro? I want to add test + fix.

kevin: minimal: `reader.read()` loop that split on `\n\n` but doesn't persist trailing bytes across reconnect. If the tab aborts or runtime rotates auth, next connection loses half-event and we JSON.parse partial.

tori: runtime note: on planned rotates we can emit a pre-rotate control event; for forced 401s we try to include resume metadata on the new stream. Clients still need to reassemble bytes.

maya: recommend SDK keep a persistent tail buffer across reconnects, split only on full `\n\n`, and optionally use server-provided seq numbers to detect gaps. Also guard JSON.parse with try/catch and requeue on failure.

vikas: plan: add tail buffer in node sdk, tests for abort/rechunk/rotate, telemetry `sse_parse_error` and `sse_resume_gap`. Will add opt-in strict seq mode when server includes `seq`.

ci-bot: Created issue #4600: "sdk-js(node): streaming parse fails on partial-chunk + auth rotate - add tail buffer & seq handling" assigned to vikas.

kevin: will update sample-app README with a small snippet showing persistent buffer + AbortController handling and recommend increasing token TTL for long streams. Thanks.
